exams.name: Conditioned Air Contractor Examination (Class I and Class II)
exams.notes: Class I restricted to systems not exceeding 175,000 BTU heating and 5 tons cooling; Class II unrestricted. Applicants who fail twice must complete a board-approved review course before a third attempt.
exams.quote: The Division of Conditioned Air Contractors shall approve separate examinations for Class I and Class II licenses. Class I licenses shall be restricted to the installation, repair, or service of conditioned air systems or equipment not exceeding 175,000 BTU (net) of heating and five tons (60,000 BTU) of cooling. Class II licenses shall be unrestricted.

interval_years.quote: Register and license or grant a certificate and issue renewal licenses and renewal certificates biennially to all persons meeting the qualifications for a license or certificate.

required.quote: The Division of Conditioned Air Contractors shall be authorized to require persons seeking renewal of Conditioned Air Contractor Class I and Class II licenses to complete board approved continuing education of not more than four hours annually.

topical_requirements.quote: Continuing education courses or programs shall be in the areas of safety, technological advances, business management, or government regulation.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any false, fraudulent, or deceitful act or the use of any forged, false, or fraudulent document in connection with the license or certificate requirements of this chapter or the rules and regulations of the board

bonding_required.quote: any such licensed conditioned air contractor or licensed plumber may execute and deposit with the judge of the probate court in the county of his or her principal place of business a bond in the sum of $10,000.00

definition_quote.value: Conditioned air contracting means the installation, repair, or service of conditioned air systems or conditioned air equipment. Service to or installation of the electrical connection between the electrical disconnect and conditioned air equipment is considered to be installation, repair, or service of conditioned air equipment or the conditioned air system. Service to or installation of the electrical circuit from the electrical distribution panel to the conditioned air equipment where the electrical service to the building or site is a single-phase electrical circuit not exceeding 200 amperes is considered to be installation, repair, or service of conditioned air equipment or the conditioned air system.
definition_quote.quote: "Conditioned air contracting" means the installation, repair, or service of conditioned air systems or conditioned air equipment.

methods_authorized.quote: "Conditioned air contracting" means the installation, repair, or service of conditioned air systems or conditioned air equipment.

system_components_included.quote: "Conditioned air equipment" means heating and air-conditioning equipment covered under state codes and the natural gas piping system on the outlet side of the gas meter.
